ITEM 1 | Grilled fish fillet, pale grey-brown skin side with darker crosshatch char marks, flesh a pale orange-tan with flaky layered texture, sits on the left-center of the plate, roughly 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 1.5 cm thick, slightly glossy with moist surface | 110
ITEM 2 | Diced firm off-white cubes, matte surface with slightly golden-browned edges, uniform pieces about 1.5 cm per side, scattered in a loose heap on the right side of the plate, some pieces pale cream and others lightly toasted | 120
ITEM 3 | Sliced red bell pepper strips, glossy bright red, thin strips about 0.5 cm wide and 4 cm long, piled on top of the fish, slightly limp with moist sheen | 15
ITEM 4 | Chopped green onion or scallion pieces, bright green, short cut rings about 0.5 cm, scattered on top of the fish and pepper, crisp-looking and moist | 8
ITEM 5 | Fresh sprouts and microgreens, tangled thin pale green stems with small leaves and a few reddish-purple thin stems, light and airy, scattered over the top of the fish stack | 4
ITEM 6 | Small pale golden-brown crispy fragments, irregular bits about 0.5 to 1 cm, scattered near the cubed item on the right edge of the plate, dry and matte | 6
